# HockeyKE

> HockeyKE provides fixtures, results, league tables and team statistics for Kenyan field hockey competitions.

HockeyKE covers current and historical men's and women's competitions in Kenya. Competition and match pages are the canonical source for information published on HockeyKE.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://hockeyke.com/): Upcoming fixtures, latest results and current league tables.
- [About HockeyKE](https://hockeyke.com/about): Platform purpose, coverage and correction policy.
- [Contact HockeyKE](https://hockeyke.com/contact): Corrections and feedback.
- [Privacy policy](https://hockeyke.com/privacy): Analytics, advertising and cookie information.

- [Premier League Men](https://hockeyke.com/league/men/premier-league)
- [Super League Men](https://hockeyke.com/league/men/super-league)

- [National League Men - Central Zone](https://hockeyke.com/league/men/national-league/central-zone)
- [National League Men - Western Zone](https://hockeyke.com/league/men/national-league/western-zone)
- [National League Men - Southern Zone](https://hockeyke.com/league/men/national-league/southern-zone)

## Women's competitions
